title: Cart navigation does not open the dedicated cart route
description: After adding a product, activating the Cart navigation link appears to leave the user on the shop route instead of opening the dedicated cart page.

steps: Add USB Hub to the cart
report.expected: The browser URL path should become /cart and the Cart page should be visible.
report.actual: The browser appears to remain on / and still shows the shop product grid.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an initially empty cart.

preconditions: User has added at least one product to the cart
User is on the shop page
steps: 1. Add a product to the cart from the shop page.
reproduction.expected: The Cart navigation link should navigate the user to the dedicated cart page.
reproduction.actual: Clicking the Cart navigation link keeps the user on the shop route instead of opening the dedicated cart page.
